name: 15640-imagechat-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1, ep1 -- a 7B model at bf16 is ~16 GB and needs no sharding on an 80 GB card.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16. Language model 28 layers, 28 query heads over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, hidden 3584, vocab 152064, context 128k; vision tower 32 layers, hidden 1280, patch_size 14, spatial_merge_size 2.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate 5.0 req/s, warmup the first 30% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 800 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn chat, one 1280x720 random-noise JPEG plus 3000 text tokens per request, 400 output tokens with ignore_eos; a request prefills ~4200 tokens, of which 1196 are vision, then decodes 400.
purpose: A vision chat assistant answering long photo-plus-text questions at five requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- the engine's reader skips indented lines, so a nested block is
# DROPPED and the engine starts without it.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: flashinfer
mem-fraction-static: 0.6
max-prefill-tokens: 5120
disable-radix-cache: true
chat-template: qwen2-vl
keep-mm-feature-on-device: true
